title: It’s okay
body: I like it, but it’d be cool if you could add more habits, etc without having to pay for premium. Feels very limited.
author: greentealeavesssssss

title: Simple but as a result, brilliant
body: Very straight forward, gives a nice monthly view of the days completed and missed which gives great perspective
author: Rawiri Kapa-Hakeney

title: Exquisite and ultra efficient in its simplicity
body: Habitify is one of those few apps that not only covers design and development with elegance and practicality, but moreover, executes one thing extremely well: track, record and encourage. It absolutely does what it proposes to do and it’s flexible enough to seriously deserve your attention. Plus, allows you export your data. No brainer really.
author: Lyondhür
